text_block_list.text:
Passing by the open-air stage by chance,
I overheard some voices coming from it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's all the commotion about, desu...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hiiiiiyaaaaaa~~♪
Everyboooodyyyy~~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The dangerous and shining
Pearl of the World, Seeking the Pearl is here!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡¿Qué?! Pearl-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nffufu♪ Thank you all for the lovely welcome♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could this be
practice for a live performance...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...My, oh my~,
it's awfully quiet out there.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And you right there, Y-O-U.
You're looking a bit pale, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so~... You had a fight
with a friend? Well, that is quite the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry! I'll make that problem
seem so tiny—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—by showing you a world-class performance!!
Brought to you by yours truly!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-World-class...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here I goooo~~♪
Mmm~ DANGEROUUUUS!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!! It started already?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Happy! Lucky!
Dangerous! Hai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Woah, Pearl-senpai's super into the groove!
—Wait, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Imaginary Crowd
text_block_list.text:
(...Happy! Lucky!
Dangerous!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sorrr-ry for being way too beautiful!
Sorrr-ry for being way too strong!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary Crowd
text_block_list.text:
(Don't worry! No problem!
More like the best! Wonderfuuul!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
T-That's weird? I feel like I can hear
something that shouldn't be heard...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can see
an invisible crowd...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now for one last shot! Let's hear it!
The beautiful Pearl of the World, her name is—?!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary Crowd
text_block_list.text:
(SEEKING THE PEARL!!
YEAAAAAHHHH——...)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A-Apassionaaaaado...!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, that's amazing desu!!
So this is world-class...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, were you watching?
Fufu, I wonder if you have the caliber of a world-class star too?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Pearl-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! Not just world-class,
El is the world! And the world is El, desu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My, that's wonderful too.
Keep giving it your all, fufu♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Guhhh, that sheer composure...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But she really was incredible, Pearl-senpai.
I wonder if I'm even anywhere close to that...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, I have to do it, desu!
Fighting spirit, motivation, El's blazing up!

I felt like I had just witnessed
something truly extraordinary—
